tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background: the Today screen, day pages, the review screen.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: The comments sheet, stat tiles, popovers (date picker, search results).

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: the task input, the ticket chip, the kbd hint, the progress track, the selected period segment's ground.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between tasks, section dividers, the notebook ruling on the comments sheet. Decorative only: never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that carry meaning: the unchecked checkbox, input borders, the outline of a stat tile. 3.2:1 or more on paper and paper-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: task text, comments, dates. On paper, paper-raised, paper-sunken and carry-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: weekday labels, timestamps, 'open 4 days', progress caption. On paper, paper-raised and paper-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-done
tokens.usage: Text of a done task, always with a strikethrough in the same colour. 4.5:1 or more on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunken, so finished work stays readable.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one action colour: checked checkbox fill, progress fill, primary button, links, focus ring, the Done count. As text, on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunken and accent-soft.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and check marks on an accent fill. Never use literal white: the dark theme's accent is light.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind accent text: the selected period segment, a search hit highlight, the 'today' dot on the date strip.

tokens.name: carry
tokens.usage: Carry-over: the '↻ 3d' marker, the Remaining count, 'open N days'. As text, on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunken and carry-soft.

tokens.name: carry-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the carry marker and of a task row that has carried 5 days or more.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions only (delete a task or comment). Text on paper and paper-raised; always paired with a word, never colour alone.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: date-display
styles.usage: The day's date at the top of Today and every day page. One per screen.

styles.name: stat-numeral
styles.usage: The Done and Remaining counts in the review stat tiles.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section headings: TODO, Comments, Review period name.

styles.name: task
styles.sample: Reply to Minh about SAAM-2134 retry logic
styles.usage: Task text. 24px line so a list reads like a ruled page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Checked the logs, the timeout comes from the upstream call, not our retry.
styles.usage: Comment text and any paragraph copy.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Captions, progress text, timestamps, weekday labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small caps labels above stat numerals and section kickers. Set uppercase in CSS.

styles.name: ticket
styles.usage: Ticket IDs inside task and comment text, and in search.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a checkbox and its marker, icon-to-label inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip and kbd padding, gap between inline items in a task row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Checkbox-to-text gap; vertical padding of a task row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, stat tile padding, comment sheet inner padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between the TODO and Comments sections; page gutter on narrow screens.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between the date header and the first section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; top margin of the day page.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkbox, ticket chip, kbd hint.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, the task input, segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Comment sheet, stat tiles, popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: date picker and search popover. Pages and cards are flat, separated by rule lines.

tokens.name: measure-day
tokens.usage: Max width of the single-column day page (tasks above comments).

tokens.name: measure-split
tokens.usage: Max width when tasks and comments sit side by side on wide screens.
